name: LC Hack
description: A hacking minigame with a fake Linux terminal, six desktops, networks, firewalls and websites. The core the other hacks build on.

name: LC Phonehack
description: Hack the phones of NPCs nearby with a laptop. Built on LC Hack.

name: LC Keyclone
description: Clone vehicle keys and door keycards with a key cloner. Built on LC Hack.

name: LC Job Garages
description: Job garages for Qbox with fully set up job vehicles, grade limits, starter items and a config generator.

name: LC Garages
description: Public, job and personal garages for Qbox, checked against the player's own vehicles.

name: LC Els
description: A standalone emergency lighting system with lights, sirens and an air horn, synced for everyone.
